method: Shopify storefront, same-origin fetch via Chrome tab. robots.txt: no Claude-specific disallow (generic AI agent guidance re: UCP/MCP, checkout only). Full catalog products.json?limit=250 = 240 products, page2 empty (complete). Furniture-department nav (site header 'FURNITURE' menu) verified via DOM anchor extraction: children = Coffee Table(coffee-table), Console(console), Dining Table(dining-table-1), End Table(end-table), Mirror(mirrors - EXCLUDED, not furniture per scope), Seating(seating), Shelf(shelf), Storage(storage).
